answer.rationale: With only 14 days to expiry and the line at 94% of committed volume, switching the critical primary supply to the low-cost vendor creates unacceptable delivery exposure given its repeated SLA misses. Preserve incumbent continuity while urgently negotiating a renewal that uses market benchmarks, an 18% spend-reduction target, and a multi-year volume commitment to seek lower unit pricing and improved payment terms. Verify the prior benchmark and multi-year savings records before committing because their applicability to this component and current market conditions remains uncertain.
